_description: Molicel INR18650-P28A. Curve digitized from lygte-info.dk's 0.2A (near-rest) discharge curve, 10% steps of measured capacity with 3.0V/cell as empty; values are approx +/-10mV. The 100% point is the cell's initial voltage under that light load, not the 4.2V charge voltage - packs above it just read 100%. Replaces a community-provided curve (from Dado), which agreed within ~30mV. Use --cell-count to match your actual pack.
